seo.description: Woodex Interior is a Lahore design studio and joinery workshop. Meet the team, our values and the way we work.

data.title: A design studio with a workshop at its heart
data.text: Founded in Lahore in 2014, Woodex Interior brings interior design and bespoke joinery under one roof.

data.title: From a joinery bench to full interiors
data.text:
Woodex began as a small workshop making kitchens for architects. Clients kept asking us to design the rooms around them — so we hired designers, and never stopped building.

Today we're a team of designers, makers and project leads delivering homes, hospitality and workplaces across Pakistan, still measuring success by how a space feels ten years on.

items.title: Calm over clever
items.text: We resist trends and design for the way a space feels day to day.

items.title: Make it properly
items.text: If we can't build it well, we don't draw it.

items.title: Decide on paper
items.text: Detailed documentation so choices happen before the site does.

items.title: Light first
items.text: Lighting is designed with the plan, not added after.

items.title: Stay accountable
items.text: One team, one site lead, one phone number.
